brief:
Israel is using artificial intelligence to rewrite Palestinian history, according to Dawn, with the technology applied to cultural heritage documentation and historical narratives. The report highlights how traditional Palestinian weaving patterns—such as those featuring "Jannah wa Sar" (Heaven and Fire) and "Jiljileh" (Little Bells)—face alteration through AI systems, threatening generational knowledge embedded in textile traditions.

Palestinian families maintain these weaving patterns as living records of displacement and cultural continuity. One family preserved two dresses featuring these distinctive patterns, inherited from a grandmother displaced from Asqalan, now called Ashkelon, during historical upheaval in the region. The use of AI to rewrite such historical documentation raises concerns about the erasure of Palestinian cultural memory and the documentation of displacement experiences tied to these traditional crafts.

title: Israel Employs AI to Alter Palestinian Historical Records
